description: Full-scale Russian invasion begins; major initial territorial losses in South and East

Biden NYT Op-Ed capping long-range weapon supply and discouraging strikes inside Russia
Kharkiv counteroffensive: Russia withdraws, Ukraine retakes Izium and Kupiansk
Gen. Mark Milley publicly urges diplomatic negotiation window following Kherson liberation
Liberation of Kherson city; Russian forces retreat across the Dnipro River
Fall of Bakhmut following multi-month war of attrition
Launch of 2023 Zaporizhzhia/Southeastern counteroffensive
US Congress passes short-term funding bill without Ukraine military aid
Zaluzhny Economist interview acknowledging the counteroffensive has reached a stalemate

VP Vance Munich Security Conference speech demanding European burden-sharing and fast talks
Trump calls Zelensky a dictator without elections on Truth Social
High-profile Oval Office clash resulting in diplomatic impasse and public disagreement
Formal pause instituted on US military assistance shipments and intelligence sharing
Russia claims recapture of Sudzha in Kursk Oblast

Ukraine reveals Operation Vivaldi near Lyman (75 sq km cleared)
